description: A Python module implementing a service for interacting with Perplexity's language model API, extending OpenAILLMService to handle Perplexity-specific token reporting and API interactions.

classes.name: PerplexityLLMService
classes.description: A specialized language model service class that interacts with Perplexity's API while maintaining compatibility with OpenAI-like interfaces, also handling Perplexity's incremental token usage reporting.

methods.name: dict build_chat_completion_params(self, params_from_context: OpenAILLMInvocationParams)
methods.description: Constructs request parameters for Perplexity chat completion, supporting OpenAI-compatible parameters.

methods.name: _process_context(self, context: OpenAILLMContext | LLMContext)
methods.description: Processes a context through the LLM, handling token usage accumulation specific to Perplexity's incremental reporting style.

methods.name: start_llm_usage_metrics(self, tokens: LLMTokenUsage)
methods.description: Accumulates token usage metrics during streaming, unlike OpenAI's final report, and reports the total at the end.

methods.name: __init__( self, *, api_key: str, base_url: str = "https://api.perplexity.ai", model: str = "sonar", **kwargs, )
